proposal_title: Complete 15-Repository Acyclic Dependency DAG & Forbidden Matrix
domain_specific_rationale: From a Red Team threat modeling perspective, enforcing a strict acyclic dependency DAG and an explicit Forbidden Dependency Matrix is essential for blast radius containment. A common exploit path in distributed multi-repo systems involves compromised worker nodes (such as browser automation scripts in R09/R10) querying relational databases directly or creating circular runtime references to bypass validation gates. CP-010 establishes hard architectural barriers: only R02 owns database access; R08 talks to R09/R10 strictly via FlowExecutionPort; and Layer 4/5 cannot bypass Layer 0 contract schemas. This provides clear segmentation against lateral movement and privilege escalation.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-07 (Security & Isolation), CAP-14 (Polyrepo Isolation), and CAP-16 (Independent Deployability).
residual_risk: Residual Risk: Developers might attempt runtime dynamic imports (eval, require with dynamic path, or RPC side-channels) that bypass static dependency linters. Required Mitigation: Implement automated AST dependency checking and import linting in CI (enforcing the matrix in 04_integration/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.md) plus network namespace segmentation ensuring worker containers physically lack direct network routes to the Postgres database port.
